items.name: theme
items.title: Edgecom Theme
items.description: Edgecom Energy design tokens (light + dark), Tailwind theme mappings, and the cn() utility. Installed automatically as a dependency of every Edgecom component.

light.font-sans: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"
light.font-mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A collapsible disclosure list; each AccordionItem pairs an AccordionTrigger with an AccordionContent panel.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A callout box laying out an optional icon, AlertTitle, AlertDescription, and a top-right AlertAction.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: The confirmation an irreversible action passes through: a Trigger opens a portalled, centered Content whose footer forces an explicit Cancel or Action choice.

items.name: application-shell
items.title: Application Shell
items.description: The portal page frame from data — a collapsible icon-rail sidebar with the logo, navigation and account menu, a top bar with the rail toggle, search, building switcher, app actions and theme toggle, and the scrolling content area — composed from the registry's sidebar, dropdown-menu, input-group, avatar and button.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A user or contact image with a text fallback. Compose Avatar with AvatarImage + AvatarFallback; stack them in an AvatarGroup with an overflow count.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact pill label (renders a span by default) for statuses, counts, and tags.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: A full-width page-level strip; BannerContent centers and lays out the contents.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A navigation trail: a Breadcrumb nav wrapping a BreadcrumbList of items, links, the current page, and separators.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A clickable button with class-variance-authority variants and sizes, including icon-only sizes.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: A container that visually joins adjacent buttons, with optional separators and text segments.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A styled react-day-picker month grid with a custom day-button renderer.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A styled container with composable header, content, and footer sections (all div-based).

items.name: category-bar
items.title: Category Bar
items.description: A single horizontal bar split into proportional colored segments, with an optional marker and numeric labels.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: The Edgecom Chart component.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox styled as a small box, with a tick when selected and a dash when indeterminate.

items.name: circular-progress
items.title: Circular Progress
items.description: A determinate ring, for a single figure that has a ceiling — a meter's share of its site total, or a job's completion.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: An open/closed disclosure: a Trigger toggles a Content panel.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable, optionally multi-select picker: an input group plus a portalled popup list, with optional selected-value chips.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable command palette; type to filter grouped, keyboard-navigable items. Wrap in CommandDialog for a ⌘K overlay.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A right-click menu: a Trigger region opens a portalled popup of items, checkboxes, radios, labels, and nested submenus.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A single-date control pairing a popover-triggering button with a Calendar.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog: a Trigger opens a portalled overlay + centered Content, with styled header/footer, title, description, and close.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A swipeable panel that slides in from an edge: a Trigger opens a portalled overlay + Content, with header/footer, title, and description.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu opened from a button: a portalled popup of groups, labels, items, checkbox/radio items, separators, shortcuts, and submenus.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: An empty-state placeholder: a dashed-border container with a header (media, title, description) and a content area for actions.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form-field scaffolding: a Field wraps a control with a label, description, and error; group fields with FieldGroup or a FieldSet.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Richer detail revealed on hover or focus: a Trigger anchors a portalled, positioned Content that escapes any clipping container.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field with focus, disabled, and invalid states.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: An input with attached add-ons. Wrap an InputGroupInput (or Textarea) with InputGroupAddon slots holding icons, text, or buttons.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input Otp
items.description: A one-time passcode split into slots, so the length of the code is visible before it is typed.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: Structured rows built from the Item primitive — media, content (title + description), and trailing actions, grouped by ItemGroup.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The Edgecom Label component.

items.name: logo
items.title: Logo
items.description: The Edgecom wordmark and glyph, with clear-space and color guidance.

items.name: motion-highlight
items.title: Motion Highlight
items.description: The Edgecom Motion Highlight component.
items.docs: Docs: no page yet — read the contract · Contract: https://design.edgecom.ai/contracts/motion-highlight.json · Guardrails: https://design.edgecom.ai/design.md

items.name: motion-tabs
items.title: Motion Tabs
items.description: The Edgecom Motion Tabs component.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: The Edgecom Multi Select component.

items.name: multi-select-listbox
items.title: Multi Select Listbox
items.description: Choosing several values at once: a trigger plus a searchable checkbox listbox with Select all and Clear. The one place a checkmark belongs. The tag-style selector on this page ships as a separate registry item.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: The platform select element, styled to match the design system — for dense forms and small screens where the OS picker is the better control.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: A horizontal nav bar: a List of items whose Triggers open Content panels, with an indicator arrow and a portalled viewport.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation for long lists and tables — previous/next controls, numbered links, and an ellipsis.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone Input
items.description: A phone number field whose country selector keeps the dial code and the number in a single value.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger: PopoverContent can hold a header (title + description) and a close button.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A progress bar: the root auto-renders a Track containing an Indicator, with optional Label and Value.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of mutually-exclusive options: a RadioGroup coordinates its RadioGroupItems.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Draggable split layouts: a PanelGroup arranges Panels separated by Handles.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scrollable region with a custom overlay scrollbar. Set orientation to vertical, horizontal, or both.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Choose one value from a list. A Root holds the value and wraps a Trigger plus a portalled, positioned Content of Items.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin divider line. Set orientation to horizontal (default) or vertical.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A dialog panel that slides in from an edge. A Trigger opens a portalled Content with header/footer, title, description, and close.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A composable application sidebar. SidebarProvider supplies collapse state; Sidebar holds a header, a scrollable body of grouped menus, and a footer, alongside a SidebarInset for the main area.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A muted placeholder block for loading states; pulses by default, or shimmers with a sweeping highlight.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A track-and-thumb control for a value or range; renders one thumb per value.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: App-wide notifications: mount one Toaster near the app root, then call the imperative toast() function to show messages.

items.name: sortable
items.title: Sortable
items.description: Drag-and-drop reordering: Sortable provides context, SortableItem wraps each entry, and SortableOverlay renders the dragged preview.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A spinning loading indicator with role=status.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: A multi-step progress flow: a nav of items (trigger, indicator, separator, title, description) with switchable content panels.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off toggle with a sliding thumb.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A styled HTML table wrapped for horizontal overflow — header, body, optional footer, rows, cells, and a caption.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A tabbed interface: a List of Triggers reveals matching Content panels.

items.name: tags-input
items.title: Tags Input
items.description: A field for entering and removing multiple tag chips, with paste-splitting and validation.

items.name: tanstack-form
items.title: Tanstack Form
items.description: The Edgecom Tanstack Form component.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: The Edgecom Textarea component.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: A vertical sequence of events. Each TimelineItem pairs a status TimelineDot with a TimelineHeading and TimelineContent, connected by a TimelineLine.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button that holds a pressed/on state.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: The Edgecom Toggle Group component.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A hover hint: a Provider shares timing, a Trigger reveals a portalled Content on hover/focus.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: Use Mobile
items.description: The Edgecom Use Mobile hook.
